text:
Jasmine (PMM): kicking off a quick handoff — need a one-slide benchmark snapshot + short blog blurb for the webinar landing page. goal: make latency vs $/token intuitive for product buyers and infra teams
Ava (Growth): love it. can we show a real workload example (search chat vs long-form generation)? that helps different segments relate.
Sam (Data Viz): thinking 2-panel: left = CDF of tail latency (p50/p95/p99) across models; right = tokens-per-query vs $/1000 tokens scatter with size=throughput. simple color key for hosted vs dedicated.
Priya (Content): i'll write the blurb. keep the headline benefit-led: "Ship LLM features at predictable cost and latency". short subtitle: "Benchmarks on typical product workloads — search, chat, summarization."
Diego (Ops): important callout: note caching and batching assumptions. our numbers assume prefix caching for chat and batching window of 20ms. otherwise cost numbers vary a lot.
Jasmine (PMM): yes include a small footnote: "Measured with Redwood runtime v1.8, batching heuristics enabled, KV prefix cache on". can we add a mini table of config knobs?
Sam (Data Viz): will mock the slide. one ask: do we show absolute $ values or relative % improvement? marketers prefer $ to hook purchase teams. infra likes % for performance claims. we can do both: $ bold, % as secondary.
Ava (Growth): inbound routing ask: when someone clicks the webinar CTA from the bench post, tag them as "bench-engaged" and route to SDRs for dedicated trials. also auto-attach the slide deck.
Priya (Content): blurb draft: "See how small ops choices — batching, caching, quantization — change latency and unit economics. We benchmark common product patterns and show practical levers to hit latency SLAs without blowing spend." thoughts?
Jasmine (PMM): clean. add a one-liner for platform teams: "Pin models, set routing policies, and keep latency predictable across regions."
Diego (Ops): routing note: add UTM param: utm_campaign=bench_launchpad&utm_source=web. also attach sample webhook payload to SDR CRM: {"lead_interest":"benchmark","engaged_slide":"bench-1"} (we'll embellish later).
Sam (Data Viz): mockup ETA: EOD tomorrow. i'll put three variants: clean two-panel, single unified scatter with annotations, and a minimal one-liner chart for social cards.
Ava (Growth): social card needs a punchline. suggestions: "Latency wins cost. Ship faster, spend less." or "Cut inference spend without trading away speed." short, punchy.
Priya (Content): prefer second one. for CTAs: "See the benchmarks" -> webinar registration; "Get a dedicated trial" -> enterprise form.
Jasmine (PMM): next steps: Sam uploads mock to the #marketing drive, Priya drops final copy by noon tomorrow, Ava wires CTA and routing, Diego confirms CRM payload and footnote copy. I'll review and finalize messaging.
BenchBot: deploy reminder scheduled: draft slide deck saved to /marketing/bench-drafts/launchpad-v1.pdf (auto), deadline: 2024-06-10 17:00 UTC.
Ava (Growth): tagging @Jasmine @Sam @Priya @Diego — thanks team, moving to execution. :rocket:
